page.layout: One page of text, single column. Woodcut ornament border at the top; heading "SUMMARIA TRACTATIONIS." centred below it; then a numbered list of summary lines running down the column, with a few lines wrapped onto indented continuation lines. A decorative line at the foot of the list ends the column. No page number, running head or catchword printed. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.head: SUMMARIA TRACTATIONIS.
main_text.l: 12. Unde proprie constitutiones ecclesiasticæ canones dictæ.
14. Antiquis magis canonis, quam juris nomen placuit, quod postea successit.
18. Differentia inter δόγματα & canones non est perpetua.
19. Paucitas canonum primis seculis, quia pauca concilia habita.
22. Primi Canones Codicis canonum, in synodo Ancyrana

page.notes: The initial "O" of item 1 is a large woodcut initial, joined to "Rigo" as "ORigo". Items 1 and 2 share the initial. Items 3 to 11 are set in italic; the numerals are roman. Item 22 ends in a damaged, partly overprinted line; "canonum" and "in synodo" are doubtful and the continuation "Ancyrana" is read from a broken hyphen. Several Greek words (items 16 and 18) were read from the scan and may be imperfect. The list is in the lower part of the page with ornamental scattered specks, which are not text.
